response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (ambulantné ošetrenie) for a fracture of the clavicle caused by an accident during a trip (spadol a zlomil si klúčnu kost). Clause A4.1 explicitly covers reasonable and necessary medical expenses, including outpatient treatment, resulting from an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions, planned treatment, or exclusionary factors such as intentional injury, alcohol, or extreme sports."}
